## HOPE has a promising functional-neuron idea. Several downstream conclusions require stronger conditions.

An independent executable audit of HOPE v1, connecting twelve major claims to
derivations, bounded counterexamples, tests, checksum-authenticated outputs,
and a proposed repair, HOPE-R.

[See the claim map](#executive-claim-map){.btn .btn-primary}

## Three conclusions to orient the reader

1. **The functional-neuron idea survives an important invariance test.** Exact
   positive rescaling can change isolated parameters by orders of magnitude
   while preserving the complete local function and its fixed-distribution
   norm. A score that changes has measured parameterization, not functional
   contribution. [`verified_fact` · Part 1](parts/01-neuron-not-filter/index.qmd)

2. **Pairwise validity does not guarantee one global Hilbert geometry.** The
   fixed Part 5 witness makes every isolated pair legal while the assembled
   three-neuron Gram table is indefinite. A scalable pair cache therefore
   needs a separate global consistency contract. [`counterexample` · Part 5](parts/05-one-hilbert-space/index.qmd)

3. **The identified contracts can be made explicit and executable.** HOPE-R
   combines one calibrated geometry, physical merge semantics, dependency
   invalidation, live resource accounting, block eligibility, and complete
   DEFT state ownership. Its local fixtures pass; trained-benchmark value
   remains an experiment. [`proposed_repair` · Part 12](parts/12-corrected-hope/index.qmd)

The project does not claim an exact reproduction of the paper's ResNet-50 on
ImageNet or complete DEFT experiments. The three conclusions above are entry
points, not substitutes for their stated assumptions and evidence boundaries.

## One claim at a time, with a public evidence trail

Every substantive conclusion follows the same traceable path:

> paper location → isolated claim → evidence label → derivation or witness →
> executable check → checksum-authenticated result

The labels distinguish `paper_claim`, `verified_fact`, `counterexample`,
`independent_inference`, `proposed_repair`, and `open_question`. A
counterexample is limited to the claim and domain it reaches, while a proposed
repair remains explicitly separate from the paper.

## Verified v1.0.0 facts

One `make test` invocation executes **252 tests** across twelve part-specific
runs and one cross-part run. `make verify-results` authenticates **95 files**:
80 CSV/JSON results and 15 editorial PNGs. The counts are per invocation, not
the sum of repeated CI matrix jobs.
:::

## Executive claim map

The labels below describe the primary audit outcome, not every record in the
part. Each article contains its complete claim-level evidence matrix.

| Part | Question and executive result | Primary evidence | Read and reproduce |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Is the functional neuron rescaling invariant?**<br>Exact positive rescaling preserves the complete local function while isolated tensor scores can change. | `verified_fact` · `independent_inference` | [Article](parts/01-neuron-not-filter/index.qmd) · [Package](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/tree/v1.0.0/experiments/audits/part01_positive_rescaling) |
| 2 | **What is inside the closed-form capacity?**<br>The biased-ReLU self-kernel is correct under the stated Gaussian marginal; its zero-shift limit exposes a simple product-score baseline. | `verified_fact` · `independent_inference` | [Article](parts/02-closed-form-capacity/index.qmd) · [Package](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/tree/v1.0.0/experiments/audits/part02_capacity) |
| 3 | **What does “data-free” assume?**<br>BatchNorm marginals do not identify a joint law; the method uses a checkpoint-carried, analytically completed model whose ranking impact remains empirical. | `verified_fact` · `independent_inference` · `open_question` | [Article](parts/03-data-free-meaning/index.qmd) · [Package](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/tree/v1.0.0/experiments/audits/part03_data_free) |
| 4 | **When is pure maximum entropy bounded?**<br>It is unbounded when feasible constraints leave an unseen direction; identity precision instead defines a reference-relative problem. | `verified_fact` · `independent_inference` · `proposed_repair` | [Article](parts/04-maximum-entropy/index.qmd) · [Package](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/tree/v1.0.0/experiments/audits/part04_maximum_entropy) |
| 5 | **Do valid pairs define one global geometry?**<br>Every pair in a fixed witness can be valid while the assembled global Gram table is indefinite. | `counterexample` · `proposed_repair` · `open_question` | [Article](parts/05-one-hilbert-space/index.qmd) · [Package](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/tree/v1.0.0/experiments/audits/part05_global_psd) |
| 6 | **Is the endpoint score uniquely forced by the axioms?**<br>It is motivated and bounded on a chosen path, but not unique once path additivity is relaxed. | `verified_fact` · `counterexample` · `proposed_repair` | [Article](parts/06-axioms/index.qmd) · [Package](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/tree/v1.0.0/experiments/audits/part06_axioms) |
| 7 | **Does abstract zero cost match the physical merge?**<br>The priced duplicated-coordinate transition can be zero for exact twins while the executed one-parent transition is nonzero. | `counterexample` · `proposed_repair` | [Article](parts/07-zero-cost-merge/index.qmd) · [Package](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/tree/v1.0.0/experiments/audits/part07_merge_semantics) |
| 8 | **Which residual blocks can be priced by the stated boundary?**<br>Eviction depends on the actual graph boundary; conditional Gaussian fixtures show sensitivity but do not identify trained ResNet statistics. | `verified_fact` · `counterexample` · `proposed_repair` | [Article](parts/08-residual-eviction/index.qmd) · [Package](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/tree/v1.0.0/experiments/audits/part08_block_eviction) |
| 9 | **What is actually constant-time?**<br>One cached lookup can be constant-time while enumeration, trajectory work, memory, dependency refresh, and live payoff are not. | `verified_fact` · `counterexample` · `proposed_repair` | [Article](parts/09-constant-time/index.qmd) · [Package](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/tree/v1.0.0/experiments/audits/part09_constant_time) |
| 10 | **What does DEFT protect?**<br>It protects a narrow route, not the complete operator; outgoing state, BatchNorm buffers, and reusable-slot lifecycle need separate contracts. | `verified_fact` · `counterexample` · `proposed_repair` | [Article](parts/10-deft-core/index.qmd) · [Package](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/tree/v1.0.0/experiments/audits/part10_deft_core) |
| 11 | **What do the published experiments establish?**<br>They provide proof-of-concept evidence, but missing protocol and uncertainty definitions prevent an exact reproduction target or universal superiority claim. | `verified_fact` · `independent_inference` · `open_question` | [Article](parts/11-experimental-evidence/index.qmd) · [Package](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/tree/v1.0.0/experiments/audits/part11_experimental_evidence) |

## Reproduce the complete frozen package

```bash
git clone https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope.git
cd hope-under-the-microscope
git checkout v1.0.0
make test
sha256sum --check artifacts/SHA256SUMS
```

[Browse the complete repository](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope) or start with
[Part 1](parts/01-neuron-not-filter/index.qmd).

## Correct, reproduce, or extend

Technical disagreement is welcome when it identifies the affected claim and
supplies a derivation, source, command, or minimal example. Use the
[correction form](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/issues/new?template=correction.yml),
[proposal form](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/issues/new?template=proposal.yml),
or [contact page](contact.qmd) to choose the appropriate public or private
channel.
